name: Etou Shirou
source:
The main character's subordinate.
Although still young, he is talented and ambitious.
He threatens the protagonist in hopes of getting promoted faster than his peers, but instead he is subjected to extreme humiliation and forced to be trained as a meat slave.
He has a lot of pride and is cunning, but not very picky.

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040529023624/http://www5.big.or.jp/~familia/so/c-space/momo.html]official website[/url]]
